text:
Eli: heads up — running through the serverless quickstart I hit two things: a dead link to the Azure guide and the example `serverless.yml` uses REDWOOD_API_TOKEN while runtime code expects REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Fern: thanks for catching. which doc path?
Eli: docs/quickstart/serverless.md — the link to azure deploy points at /deploy/old-azure which 404s. and the YAML snippet in the "Configure credentials" section exports `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN`.
Gus: yep, that mismatch will confuse folks during first deploys. small PR should fix both. also the deploy command in the example omits `--region` for GCP, which trips newbies.
Eli: proposal: 1) replace dead Azure link with https://www.redwood.ai/guides/azure-serverless (the updated guide) 2) standardize to REDWOOD_API_KEY across snippets (bash, yml, docker compose) 3) add a short troubleshooting note and a CI smoke that lints for the old var name and verifies links.
Fern: good plan. can you also tweak the serverless example to show the minimal `redwood deploy --provider gcp --region us-central1` so people don't copy a bad command?
Gus: +1. Also add a tiny snippet showing how to set env for GitHub Actions: `REDWOOD_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY }}` — a lot of users paste the wrong format.
Eli: will do. I'll open the PR and include a small `scripts/check_snippets.sh` that: `git grep -n "REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" || true` and runs linkcheck on the updated doc.
snippet-bot: quick lint: detected 1 occurrence of REDWOOD_API_TOKEN in examples/serverless/template.yml (line 12).
Fern: perfect — include that grep output as an artifact in the PR so reviewers can see no other matches remain.
Eli: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/783 — fixes link, updates env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, adds GH Actions snippet, updates deploy command examples, adds snippet lint job and linkcheck.
Gus: i'll review runtime bits and sanity-check the `serverless.yml` with our deploy team. adding @eng-runtime as a reviewer.
Fern: nit: update the troubleshooting blurb to say "If deploy fails with 401, confirm REDWOOD_API_KEY is set and your token begins with `sk-`." keeps the advice short.
Eli: added that sentence. also added a tiny note: "For CI placeholder tokens (e.g. sk-test), the linkcheck step will skip live calls."
deploy-bot: docs CI started for PR 783 (job: docs-ci)
deploy-bot: docs CI: snippet-lint passed; linkcheck found 0 dead links; docs build succeeded (duration: 2m 34s).
Gus: LGTM. I ran the template through a dry run on staging and the env names line up.
Fern: merging. i'll add a one-line mention in the next release notes under "Quickstart & onboarding fixes".
Eli: file follow-up issue to add a docs linter rule that errors on `REDWOOD_API_TOKEN` in snippets so this doesn't regress.
Eli: follow-up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/232 — added a short description and assigned to docs-squad.
Gus: thanks all. should cut down support noise for first deploys. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
